chunks: # ClinicQueue Multispecialty Clinic & Healthcare Center ## Comprehensive Hospital Information & Patient Guide ### 1. Hospital Overview & Mission ClinicQueue Multispecialty Clinic is a modern, state-of-the-art outpatient healthcare facility dedicated to providing compassionate, efficient, and affordable medical care. Our facility integrates smart walk-in digital queues, pre-scheduled specialist appointments, an in-house digital pharmacy, and advanced pathology diagnostics under one roof. ### 2. Location & Address - **Address**: ClinicQueue Healthcare Center, 42 Metro Wellness Boulevard, Health City, Sector 5. - **Landmark**: Opposite Central Metro Station, Gate No. 2. - **Accessibility**: 100% wheelchair accessible with ramp access, patient elevator, and dedicated patient drop-off zone. - **Parking**: Complimentary basement valet parking for patients and emergency visitors. ### 3. ClinicQueue offers specialized outpatient care across 8 primary departments: 1. **General Medicine & Family Practice**: Comprehensive diagnosis, acute illnesses, diabetes, hypertension, fever, and routine checkups. 2. **Cardiology**: Heart health, ECG, 2D-Echocardiogram, blood pressure management, and cardiovascular risk screening. 3. **Dermatology & Cosmetology**: Skin, hair, and nail conditions, allergy testing, acne, eczema, and laser dermatology. 4. **Neurology**: Headaches, migraines, epilepsy, nerve disorders, neuropathy, stroke rehabilitation, and memory care. 5. **Orthopedics & Joint Care**: Bone fractures, joint pain, arthritis management, spine care, and sports injury recovery. 6. **Pediatrics & Child Health**: Newborn care, child growth assessment, immunizations, childhood infections, and pediatric wellness. 7. **ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat)**: Hearing assessments, sinus treatment, throat infections, tonsil evaluations, and vertigo care. 8. **Dental & Oral Health**: Teeth cleaning, digital X-rays, root canals, braces, fillings, and pediatric dental hygiene. ### 6. Consultation Fees & Tariff Structure - **General Physician Consultation**: $35 (Initial visit) | $20 (Follow-up within 7 days) - **Specialist Consultation** (Cardiology, Neurology, Orthopedics, Dermatology, ENT, Pediatrics): $45 to $75 depending on specialty. - **Dental Consultation & Examination**: $35. - **Emergency Room Triage & Assessment**: $50 baseline assessment fee. - **Follow-up Policy**: Any follow-up consultation within 7 days for the same ailment receives a discounted rate. ### 7. Payment Modes & Insurance Empanelment - **Accepted Modes**: Cash, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, UPI, and debit cards. - **Health Insurance & Cashless TPA**: We are empanelled with all major health insurance providers. Patients with valid health insurance cards can avail cashless outpatient coverage or get instant claim reimbursement paperwork. ### 8. Smart Queue Management & Priorities ClinicQueue operates a fair, modern triage queue system: - **Emergency Priority**: Immediate priority consultation without waiting for acute trauma, severe chest pain, shortness of breath, or critical symptoms. - **Senior Citizen Priority**: Patients aged 60 and

Patients with valid health insurance cards can avail cashless outpatient coverage or get instant claim reimbursement paperwork. ### 8. Smart Queue Management & Priorities ClinicQueue operates a fair, modern triage queue system: - **Emergency Priority**: Immediate priority consultation without waiting for acute trauma, severe chest pain, shortness of breath, or critical symptoms. - **Senior Citizen Priority**: Patients aged 60 and above automatically receive priority queue status over standard tokens. - **Normal Walk-in Priority**: First-In, First-Out (FIFO) token allocation. - **Digital Tracking**: Patients can check their live line position (`#X in queue`) anytime via our website or Telegram bot. ### 9. Laboratory & Diagnostic Facilities - Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver & Kidney Function Tests (LFT/KFT), HbA1c, Thyroid Panel (TSH, T3, T4). - 12-lead Digital ECG, Holter monitoring, 2D Echocardiography. - Digital X-Ray (low radiation) and High-Resolution Ultrasound / Sonography. - Fast turnaround: Routine blood tests available in under 2 hours; digital reports sent via SMS & WhatsApp.
